About this item

  • 【Leather Hardcover Spiral Notebook】Premium leather combine cardboard constituted a sturdy waterproof cover, prevent coffee、water from wetting the inner pages and against the notebook tabs /pages from bending, while 4 golden metal-corners and thick twin- spiral binding, further protect your important meeting records or work school note well. A kind side pen loop design, which reduce the frequency that losing pens.
  • 【5 Adjustable Dividers with 8 Tabs】Our 5 subject notebook include 5 removable plastic dividers, flexible and durable so you can move and organize them as your wish. It can be divided into 5 sections in total, which had enough features to keep organized on different subjects, instead of piles of random spiral notebooks that will slimmed your backpack down a ton! Come with 8 self-adhesive labels that separate information and make it easy to find categories to help organize your notes effectively.
  • 【300 Pages Thick Notebook】Large B5 size notebook 8"x10" with 300 pages /150 sheet for long-term storage will reduce the amount of notebooks you buy! Acid-free light Ivory paper that protect your eyes. High-quality 100GSM thick page create smoother writing process and prevent ink bleeding through or ghosting. 7.1mm college ruled spiral notebook and the top of each page are sections for“Weather”,“Week”,“Memo No” and “Date” to meet your daily note writing needs.
  • 【Easy Writing at 180°Lay Flat】Thick twin-spiral binding less likely to fall apart and easy to turn the pages to ensures that the notebook lays flat when open,making writing a breeze even for left handed writers. Elastic closure band keep your spiral journal secure when closed and can also be used as a bookmark to keep track where you wrote. An expandable back pocket that is great for storing extra notes, cards, or other important items.
  • 【Hardcover Notebooks for Work School】This spiral 5 subject notebooks is an excellent choice for students, professionals, or anyone who like to write things down and needs to keep them organized. A stylish look with gold color stamp font, binding brighten up your dreary desk, also a wonderful gift to work organization, back to school or family records.

Product description

The leather 5 subject notebook you've been looking for！！

5 Subject notebooks for people who like to write things down and needs to keep them organized

  • Premium leather combined with cardboard cover is thick and waterproof to protect the inner paper and tabs from bending and getting wet
  • 4 Round metal corner prevent you from accidentally being scratched during daily use, while reducing the wear of notebook and adding aesthetic appeal.
  • Tight elastic strap keeps it closed in you backpack and won't make a mess of the paper, meanwhile it can also be used as a bookmark to hold the current page when writing notes.
  • Side elastic pen holder can hold a variety of pen sizes, no more forgetting to bring a pen and educe the frequency of losing pens
  • Gold-stamp font with simple spiral notebook design adding an elegant and classic touch

This hardcover spiral notebook has a wide range of applications. You can use it as basic meeting records, study records, travel diary records, etc. It is also a good choice as a gift for friends, family and colleagues.

5 Subject Notebook with 5 removable divider and 8 self-adhesive tabs

  • 5 colored removable dividers with 8 self-adhesive tabs, you can mark each section by name with 8 stickers, organizing different topics instead of multiple random notebooks
  • 100 GSM no bleed through withstand most of daliy pen，thick ivory paper provides no bleeding through, no smearing, no ghosting or no feathering writing experience for you.
  • 180° lays flat provides a comfortable writing experience, whether you are left or right-handed. It can even be fold 360° to frees up desktop space
  • 7.1mm college ruled applies to most notes, give you enough space to write.

Worried about paper getting wet?

  • The surface of our notebook cover is made of waterproof leather, which prevents the inner paper from being soiled by water or coffee, further protects your precious notes.
  • The hard, thick cardboard inside provides great support when you're writing

Different subjects require different thickness？

Movable dividers allow to adjust the pages to suit the length of the notes, and the PVC plastic materials are easy to clean and durable to withstand daily flip over

Worried about paper falling?

  • Metal material holds the paper tightly like a pair of big hands, no more worry about pages fall apart
  • The Twin-ring binding provides enough space for smooth page turns

Helpful inner pocket

An expand inner pocket help to storage for miscellaneous items such as cards, note pads, etc.

300 Pages B5 size spiral notebook for school work

  • The sturdy leather cover is designed to be 0.7in wider than the paper, effective protecting the divider label from bending
  • 300 pages thick notebook, enough to meet the needs of long-term use, and the spiral binding makes it easy to tear out pages without disturbing the rest of the notebook
  • It can be evenly divided into 60 pages，or move the dividers adjust the subject page as you need

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

5 out of 5 stars
Pretty, practical, and perfectly organized!
I absolutely love this notebook! From the moment I opened it, I could tell it was well-made and thoughtfully designed. The floral hardcover is gorgeous, but it's the functionality that really makes this notebook stand out. The sturdy hardcover protects the pages from getting bent or damaged, making it perfect for work, home, or carrying in a bag. One of my favorite features is the gold spiral binding—it lays completely flat while writing, which is a huge plus for me. The colorful tabbed dividers are what truly make this notebook special. I can easily label each section and keep different projects, notes, lists, and ideas organized all in one place. No more flipping through endless pages trying to find what I need! Pros: ✔ Beautiful floral design that looks professional and stylish ✔ Durable hardcover protects pages ✔ Gold spiral binding allows notebook to lay flat ✔ Multiple tabbed sections for easy organization ✔ Plenty of writing space on lined pages ✔ Perfect for work, school, budgeting, meal planning, or journaling ✔ High-quality construction that feels built to last Final Thoughts: If you're someone who loves being organized, this notebook is a dream. It combines beauty, durability, and functionality in one package. The tabbed sections make it incredibly easy to stay organized, and the hardcover and spiral binding are exactly what I look for in a notebook. This may honestly be the perfect notebook I've found so far!
